scope: ISO 32000-2 clause 9.9, Table 124; font layouts from the referenced Type 1, CFF/Type 2 and OpenType formats. Analytic expectations from independent Python writers.

requirements.status: TrueType simple and composite outlines, cmap 0/4/6/12, hmtx and post
requirements.gaps: No hint execution; post versions 1/2/3; other post and cmap formats remain unsupported.

requirements.status: CFF/CID CFF INDEX, DICT, charsets, encodings, FDSelect, Type 2 and default-instance CFF2
requirements.gaps: Expert predefined charsets/encoding, standard expert SIDs, FDSelect format 4 and Private DICT blends remain unsupported.

requirements.status: Type 1 PFA/PFB framing, eexec and charstring ciphers, subroutines, flex and seac
requirements.gaps: Static dictionary extraction; computed PostScript dictionaries and custom OtherSubrs are unsupported.

requirements.status: Bounded reads, counts, stacks, subroutine/glyph recursion and interpreter operations
requirements.gaps: Budget violations are syntax errors with standalone-buffer positions; malformed outlines are reported lazily.
